Hi Elena —

Great to meet earlier. Quick post-demo recap focused on compliance items we discussed and clear next steps so your procurement and security teams have what they need: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Aurelia requested the latest Type II report and a short bridge letter while the current period completes.
- HIPAA / GDPR: We have a HIPAA attestation and DPA template; happy to confirm data processing details by workload.
- Vendor security questionnaire (DDQ): If you prefer, we can kick off a VSQ in TrustPortal and upload artifacts.

Attachments: post-demo-security-checklist.pdf (short checklist and suggested artifacts).

Can you confirm: 1) the two emails to invite to the portal, and 2) a procurement contact for contracting/POs? Once we have that, I’ll loop in our compliance ops and have the bridge letter + SOC2 request sent to you.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan

Priya / Lauren —

Following Elena’s ask (below) I’m proposing an internal checklist to move quickly: 

1) SOC2 request: I’ll open a compliance request for the latest Type II report and mark it as "Aurelia — expedited". Compliance aim: gather report / scope and any restricted redactions.
2) Bridge letter: Use our standard bridgeletter-draft.docx (attached) and tailor to Aurelia’s scope. Priya — will you ok the customer-facing language?
3) TrustPortal invites: Lauren — can you provision portal access for elena.morgan@aureliahealth.com and rob.garcia@aureliahealth.com and set role=Reviewer (artifact view only) and expiry 30 days? Please also create a secure folder named "Aurelia Security Intake" and upload the bridge letter and SOC2 request form. Link: https://trust.redwood.ai/admin
4) VSQ / DDQ: If Aurelia prefers, we can instantiate a standard VSQ and auto-send the questionnaire; otherwise we’ll upload artifacts and attach a short checklist.
5) Contracting/procurement: Priya — confirm whether we need to route a quote to procurement@aureliahealth.com and whether a PO number is required before portal provisioning.

Timeline proposal: SOC2 + bridge letter draft within 48 hours of access confirmed; portal invites within 24 hours of Lauren provisioning.

Attachments: bridgeletter-draft.docx, soc2-request-form.pdf

Ben
Security & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
